description:
Resolve an IP (IPv4 or IPv6) to city, region, country, lat/long, timezone, ASN, and currency. Omit the ip field to geolocate the caller.

upAPI operation `ip-geolocation.get` (Data). Costs 1 unit of monthly quota per call.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address; omit to geolocate the caller
ip.title: Ip

title: Geolocate IP Address
